facts.text: Night Temple stands at the boundary of the Hollow Mountains and their fog.

Bastion lies in the central region of the Dream Realm, at the heart of Valor's territory.
Bastion once belonged to the Demon of Imagination, and its castle and lake are an illusion that outlived the daemon.
The real castle hides in the reflection of the false one, and True Bastion is a Death Zone.
The Great Mirror lies in a hall deep in the mountain under the castle and lets true and false Bastion swap places.

Queen Song's clan holds the palace, the Gateway, and the ice caves beneath Ravenheart.
The Sword Domain calls the Raven Queen the Queen of Worms.
After the Raven Queen fell, Kai took Ravenheart without bloodshed and ruled it.
facts.until: the clans are gone and the city spreads into a vast one; Seishan later reclaims the Jade Palace

Noctis broke the Sun God's will by freeing Hope.

Bright Castle was the main settlement of the Forgotten Shore.
Bright Castle eventually fell to Nightmare forces.
The Crimson Spire predated the Forgotten Shore's fall and was built by its ancient civilization.
Asterion was trapped on Earth's Moon for decades by Anvil of Valor and Ki Song.

The Antarctica Campaign was fought in the far south to secure an ancient power.

The Shadow Clan under Sunny operates invisibly across all factions.
The Cults of the Lost Gods serve the Dark Lord, known in Government intelligence as B10.
Monger was destroyed in the Doom War but his theological legacy persists.
The Monger cult worships pain and voluntary transformation through Nightmare creature essence.
Whether the Dream King is a sentient being or purely an administrative function is speculative.
Old Tom is immortal and may be Divine or predate the Divine and human distinction.
The Dream King defers to Old Tom for a reason that is unknown.
Old Tom enforces the Covenant of the First and maintains awareness of its sanctuaries.
Shadow Clan intelligence estimates 50-200 active Three Moons cult agents across the Citadels.
Sunny is publicly known as the Shadow Saint.
The Shadow Clan's power base is the Hollow Mountains.
Sunny beheaded Anvil, collapsing the Sword Domain.
Gunlaug ruled the Forgotten Shore before its fall.

Master Orum was an ally of Ki Song in the early Academy era.

The Salvage Corps is affiliated with the Government and trained to clear and extract from ruins.

The Blood Mystics are a major faction identified by dark red colors.

Cassie's abilities may be linked to the Nameless Temple.

Morgan's specific role, faction, and fate are unknown.

Sunny is the second-in-command of the Fire Keepers.

Sunny rules the Hollow Mountains.

Nephis is a living Sovereign, one of the most powerful Awakened in history.
Sunny is the living Shadow Saint, the most individually powerful Awakened after Nephis.

Orum was a male Master and Ki Song's own teacher, executed by Anvil of Valor.
Nephis carries the Luminous aspect while Sunny's primary aspect is Shadow, not Luminous.
Cassie's canonical Flaw is Blindness; she is literally blind and sees through prophecy.

Ariel is a separate being, the Demon of Dread, and not the Spell's architect.

Weave Ward nodes are part of the Weave infrastructure and are decorated with geometric or symbolic designs.
The character of the Nightmare appears in countless stories, and its true nature is unclear.
Cassie receives visions of possible future events, some vivid and some symbolic.
Cassie holds the Bleeding Mirror, which grants minor future-sight at a bleeding cost.
Gunlaug rose to rule Bright Castle in the ruins of Dark City.
Gunlaug reportedly commands an elite personal unit called the Sovereign's Guard.
Some accounts claim Gunlaug survived the Forgotten Shore's destruction and later fought in the Stormsea conflict.
Mordret is obsessed with Sunny, whose complete soul he believes could cure his identity dissolution.
Mordret claims a blood-based connection to Sunny, but Sunny rejects it and they did not grow up together.
The Weaver is one of the seven Daemons, not eight.
Ki Song elevated the Song Clan from a lesser clan to a Great Clan.
Whether Ki Song belongs to the seven-house structure is not confirmed.
Kai rises to a senior position within Nephis's organization after the major Nightmare events.
The Antarctica Campaign took place in Antarctica.
Old Tom may be the Covenant enforcer when Covenant protections are invoked.
The Dream King exists as the Dream Realm's administrative entity.
He may have destroyed entire Citadels such as the Forgotten Shore if the system required it.
Professor Julius is a historian and scholar at the Awakened Academy.
Sunny's primary Aspect is the Shadow Slave Aspect, a unique Shadow class.
Sunny possesses the Shadow Realm, a Sovereign-level domain of absolute darkness tied to his will.
An army sleeps in stasis inside the Shadow Realm, waiting for the one who can wake them.
Sunny is the only one who can wake and command the sleeping shadow army.
Shadow creatures are native inhabitants of the Shadow Realm born of Void-adjacent darkness.
A Shadow Horror was the first creature Sunny absorbed, bound permanently to his soul as a sentinel.
Nephis wields the Luminous aspect as pure light and purification.
It is claimed a Shadow Bond between Nephis and Sunny links their souls and amplifies their power.
The Academy does not train Shadow users because the Aspect is too rare.
facts.until: Sunny developed Shadow Clan training methods

facts.text: The Void is one of the things the Spell sealed, and shadow arts align users with its nature.
Dark Sovereigns are the fourth tier of the Shadow Creature hierarchy, at Divine level.
The Spell was designed to keep the Forgotten God imprisoned.
Corruption is imprisoned and is a process, a wound in existence, not a living creature.
The Abyssal Leviathan occasionally manifests in the Dream Realm.
The Abyssal Leviathan cannot be permanently killed and must be contained.
The Dream King's Servants are extensions of his will serving the Spell's infrastructure.
Some human communities negotiate relationships with creatures, and the Banshees honor such agreements.
The Government classifies all Monger cult members as biological terrorist threats.
The Monger cult deliberately breeds Nightmare creatures with humans, creating hybrids that pass as human.
Power Nodes spawn higher-tier creatures through concentrated essence.
Shades, Crawlers and Phantoms are common Fear-Born creatures always present in the Dream Realm.
The power of the Dream King's Servants varies, some Fallen-equivalent, some Cursed.
Nephis's First Aspect is Luminous, a fire-based power used for purification.
Sunny's First Aspect is Shadow, used for concealment and evasion.
Sunny is bound to Nephis through the Shadow Bond and fights among the Fire Keepers.
Cassie's First Aspect is Dream, granting foresight and pattern reading.
Kai's First Aspect is Wind, favoring speed and ranged tactics.
Jet's First Aspect is Fire, suited to aggressive combat.
Effie's First Aspect is Strength, suited to endurance and pack tactics.
The Three Moons Cult is confirmed as an existential threat that attacked through the Third Nightmare.
Some houses of the Song Domain believe Nephis causes Nightmares and seek war with the Fire Keepers.
A Category 5 Nightmare destroyed the old Citadel at the Forgotten Shore in about twelve hours.
Roughly fifty thousand people are said to have died in the Forgotten Shore Collapse.
In the Third Nightmare the Three Moons Cult attacked, and Nephis's flame saved Sunny through the Shadow Bond.
Some believe the Dream King's administrative decision destroyed the Forgotten Shore.
The Three Moons Cult considers Sunny's True Name its greatest prize.
Mordret collects Nightmare Echoes for unknown purposes.
Cassie's Luminous Bond anchored Sunny during the Third Nightmare.
Aiko conducts operational readiness reviews for the Shadow Clan.
Nephis suspects the Dream King of manipulating Nightmares.
Nephis is not the First Awakened; others Awakened before her.
Ki Song's legacy frames survival as divine duty for the Song Domain.
The Dream King's interest in Sunny confirms his long game.

facts.o: the spell's true purpose remains hidden
facts.text: The Spell's true purpose remains hidden from all factions.
It is theorized the Spell escalates Nightmares to produce stronger Awakened faster.
Mordret's Memory Reflection ability turns an opponent's own abilities against them.
Direct combat with a Sovereign is not viable for anyone below Rank 5.
Nephis possesses a flame range ability useful for area-of-effect attacks.
The Modern Citadel Era is marked as unverified lore.
The Three Moons Cult is marked as unverified lore.
The Cults of the Lost Gods are a known religious faction.
Anvil was the Forge Sovereign, architect of the ancient world's military technology.
The Anvil Clan is the former Valor Clan, Anvil's pre-Doom War smith-guild.
Modern Anvil Clan smiths can consistently produce Tier 3 weapons.
The Anvil Clan makes portable essence forges for field repair and crafting.
Power Nodes can amplify a Sovereign's territorial claim through domain amplification.
Weave Telephone pairs must be attuned at a Weave Node to anchor the channel.
A Phase Cloak lets the wearer pass through non-magical walls once per day.
Weave Tethers are grappling hooks that can anchor to thin air in the Dream Realm.
Anvil's forge made artifacts channeling Divine power without corrupting the wielder; the technique is not fully replicated.
Those within Mordret's Domain gradually lose their sense of self.
Mordret can manifest copies of anyone whose memories he has absorbed.
Mordret can temporarily overwrite the will of anyone within his Domain.
Mordret's Domain is why he is considered the most dangerous Sovereign.
Mordret grows stronger from every Sovereign who cannot decisively eliminate him.
Mordret absorbs enemy Awakened to grow his collection of reflections.
Awakened operate from Citadels and transit through Gates to reach Nightmare zones.
Citadels are defensive positions used by Awakened forces.
Gates are dimensional transit points within the survival network.
Domains are Sovereign powers projected over Citadels to enhance defense.
Sovereigns project Domains over Citadels; Domains without Citadels are powerful but not sustainable.
Sunny is the Shadow Saint, whose shadow arts corrupt him slowly.
The Monger Cult performs voluntary transformation, hybridization, and self-harm pain rituals.
The Vessels Faction worships and protects vessel children while researching Forgotten God summoning.
The Three Moons Cult believes collecting True Names will shatter the Spell's cage.
Heretics preach that the Spell is a prison enslaving humanity, though this is unconfirmed.
The Weaver is the Architect of the Spell and continues research with unknown goals.
The Weaver's ultimate goal is unknown; it may seek to improve or break the Spell.
House Veil secretly researches Spell mechanics, soul mechanics, and True Names.
Vessel children are exploited within Citadel society as labor, students, and assets.
Corruption expands while the Citadels shrink, and humanity slowly loses ground.
The Great Dreamer's exact nature, powers, and fate are shrouded in myth.
The Nine Sovereigns were the Divine-rank Awakened who ruled pre-Spell humanity.
Cruel Sight is Sunny's primary weapon, forged from shadow and nightmare.
Cruel Sight was created through Sunny's Weave Aspect enchantment abilities.
The Shadow Lantern is Sunny's access device to the Shadow Realm.
Sunny eventually claims the Mortal Blade or its power.
The Mortal Blade was forged by Weaver, the architect of reality.
The Great Mirror was originally owned by the Demon of Imagination.
The Great Mirror creates the Hall of Imagination beneath True Bastion.
Mordret is the heir to the Demon of Imagination's power.
The Diamond Cross is in Nephis's possession and amplifies her flame abilities.
Endless Violet is a soul charm in Nephis's possession.
Jet consumes something connected to the Heart of Kanakht, gaining Soul Reaper powers.
Puppeteer's Shroud is Sunny's armor Memory that saved his life many times.
Starlight Legion Armor is an Awakened-rank armor Memory obtained by Sunny.
Sunny obtained the Starlight Legion Armor after defeating the Carapace Centurion on the Forgotten Shore.
The Shadow Legion is Sunny's personal army of bound shadow soldiers.
Shadow soldiers can be summoned instantly within the Hollow Mountains territory.
Sunny was born and lived as a slave in the Outskirts.
The Death Game is the Nightmare Spell's ultimate challenge where Awakened compete for the Weave Lineage items.
The three Weave Lineage items are left as rewards in the Death Game.
Sunny has an Infinite Soul Sea that can absorb unlimited Essence and never depletes.
Mordret's soul absorption is said to be a Covenant violation.
Cassie receives visions of the future at the cost of pieces of herself.
The Shadow Clan operates on a merit-based, anonymous system.
Weaver continues research into the Spell.
The Spell may weaken, break, or strengthen; its future is uncertain.
